Enterprise software / CRM and ERP

GEO for CRM and ERP software vendors in AI recommendations

Sales teams select CRM for pipelines and customer interaction, while operations and finance may need ERP for inventory, procurement and resource management. I measure whether AI recommends a product for its actual use cases and check the evidence behind those recommendations.

  • Separate demand for CRM, ERP, integrations and deployment
  • Verify product editions, technical documentation and capabilities
  • Explain project cost as well as the subscription price
Discuss your projectSee the industry method

Personally led by Alexey Yakovlev, GEO/AEO consultant

Selection barriers

Why a broad automation promise is insufficient

A product name may appear in AI answers even when its functions and implementation conditions are misrepresented. Buyers need edition-specific evidence.

01

CRM and ERP are conflated

Sales and customer-service workflows differ from procurement, finance, stock and production. They require distinct buyer-intent groups.

02

Integration claims are vague

Saying a product integrates with 1C does not establish supported editions, interfaces, sync direction or deployment conditions.

03

Licence cost is mistaken for full project cost

Data migration, training, custom work, integration testing and support can materially change the budget.

Buyer intents

CRM and ERP buying questions worth tracking

Separate platform selection, implementer selection and specific industry requirements while retaining stable query groups for repeat measurements.

Buyer questionWhat to verifyGEO task
Which CRM suits a 20-person sales team?Pipelines, roles, reporting, telephony, editions and subscription limitsExplain real features and plan constraints
Which ERP supports purchasing and inventory across several warehouses?Modules, master data, stock, permissions and branch processesDocument actual supported workflows
Which CRM works with our specific 1C configuration?Connectors, versions, sync directions, update cadence and assumptionsIntegration pages and concrete examples
What does migrating from an old ERP cost?Data volume, cleaning, test cycles, downtime and acceptanceDescribe migration scope and estimation factors
Verifiable facts

Evidence behind a credible enterprise-software recommendation

Microsoft's implementation guidance distinguishes configuration from migrated data and includes integration and go-live testing. It offers useful procurement criteria without proving that a named third-party platform implements them.

  • Product and editions: supported functions, limits, security model and current documentation
  • Data and delivery: APIs, 1C connectors, migration strategy, tests and acceptance criteria
  • Commercial terms: licences, implementation, customisation, onboarding and support under actual agreements

GAEO's technical B2B research method supports these checks. The MethodLab website-performance case is not presented as a CRM/ERP GEO result.

Scope of work

A GEO plan for a CRM or ERP provider

I start with the concrete jobs buyers need performed, then map missing or inaccurate evidence in sources AI can consult.

  1. 01

    Baseline

    Separate CRM, ERP, integration, deployment and industry queries; record BMR and the recommended products.

  2. 02

    Product verification

    Review real editions, modules, documentation, licensing and publishable customer references.

  3. 03

    Content specifications

    Define pages for workflows, integrations, migration, implementation costs and comparisons.

  4. 04

    Repeat measurement

    Check BMR, cited sources and factual errors with equivalent prompts and platforms.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Should CRM and ERP have separate landing pages?+

Yes when they represent different products or workflows. The relevant buyer roles and selection criteria differ.

What demonstrates 1C compatibility?+

Verified versions, a documented connector, data flow and implementation scope. A generic integration badge is not sufficient.

Can one figure represent ERP implementation cost?+

Only for an explicitly specified scope. Complex deployments require a project estimate that covers licences and services.

Which deployment results belong in a case study?+

Only documented project outcomes and details authorised for publication. Do not invent installation counts or time savings.

How much does GAEO charge for CRM or ERP GEO?+

GAEO's standard audit and monthly pricing applies. Broader prompt, platform and content scope is calculated separately.
